DIAMETER::header version [newvesion]
get or set version
DIAMETER::header rflag|request-flag [newflag]
get or set r(request) flag. possible return value is 0 or 1.
DIAMETER::header pflag|proxiable-flag [newflag]
get or set p(proxiable) flag. possible return value is 0 or 1.
DIAMETER::header eflag|error-flag [newflag]
get or set e(error) flag. possible return value is 0 or 1.
DIAMETER::header tflag|retransmitted-flag [newflag]
get or set t(potentially retransmitted message) flag. possible return
value is 0 or 1.
DIAMETER::header flags [newflag]
get or set all flags (as unsigned char)
DIAMETER::header appid [newappid]
get or set application-id
DIAMETER::header hopid [newhopid]
get or set hop-by-hop identifier
DIAMETER::header endid [newendid]
get or set end-to-end identifier
